name: AM-1235
summary: AM-1235 (1-(5-fluoropentyl)-3-(naphthalen-1-oyl)-6-nitroindole) is a drug that acts as a potent and reasonably selective agonist for the cannabinoid receptor CB1.

pharmacology.text: AM-1235 is a cannabinoid receptor agonist with Ki of 1.5 nM at CB1 compared to 20.4 nM at CB2. While the 6-nitro substitution on the indole ring reduces affinity for both CB1 and CB2 relative to the unsubstituted parent compound AM-2201, CB2 affinity is reduced much more, resulting in a CB1 selectivity of around 13 times.

uses.en: It is a research compound used to study the cannabinoid receptors, and has also appeared in synthetic cannabinoid products.
uses.zh: 它是用來研究大麻素受體的研究用化合物，也曾出現在合成大麻素產品中。
uses.zhHans: 它是用来研究大麻素受体的研究用化合物，也曾出现在合成大麻素产品中。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cannabinoids, can cause a racing heart, agitation, vomiting, confusion, seizures and psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。同類的合成大麻素可能造成心跳急促、躁動、嘔吐、混亂、癲癇發作與精神病。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。同类的合成大麻素可能造成心跳急促、躁动、呕吐、混乱、癫痫发作与精神病。

fact.en: Its fluorine atom sits at the end of a five carbon chain. Chemists added fluorine there to slow down how fast the body chops the chain up, a trick used across this family of compounds.
fact.zh: 它的氟原子位於五個碳的鏈末端。化學家在那裡加上氟，是為了減緩身體分解該鏈的速度，這是這一類化合物常用的手法。
fact.zhHans: 它的氟原子位于五个碳的链末端。化学家在那里加上氟，是为了减缓身体分解该链的速度，这是这一类化合物常用的手法。
